boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain California State Polytechnic University-Pomona
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Pomona food stops with late service verified through current official university or restaurant pages. Several switch to drive-through-only service late at night.

cards.title: The Around-the-Clock Diner
cards.subtitle: West Temple Avenue, beside Cal Poly Pomona
cards.notes: Choose this nearby diner when the hour is unpredictable; confirm ordering availability online before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A full-service diner beside campus with nearly continuous daily hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's identifies this Pomona restaurant at 3012 West Temple Avenue and lists daily store hours from 12:00 AM to 11:58 PM.
cards.source_title: Denny's at 3012 West Temple Avenue, Pomona
cards.access_notes: Official hours are 12:00 AM–11:58 PM daily; online-order acceptance may end earlier than the dining room schedule.

cards.title: The Temple Avenue Drive-Through
cards.subtitle: West Temple Avenue, immediately south of campus
cards.notes: Use the Temple Avenue location for a close late run, and check whether restaurant or drive-through access applies.
cards.short_summary: A campus-adjacent fast-food counter with service past midnight every night.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's official location page identifies 3077 W Temple Ave and lists restaurant and drive-through hours until 1:00 AM Sunday–Wednesday and 2:00 AM Thursday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Wendy's at 3077 W Temple Ave, Pomona
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-through close at 1:00 AM Sunday–Wednesday and 2:00 AM Thursday–Saturday.

cards.title: The Garey Avenue 3:30 Run
cards.subtitle: North Garey Avenue in Pomona
cards.notes: Save this for very late food on selected nights; read the day-by-day schedule because Monday closes earlier.
cards.short_summary: A North Garey fast-food stop serving until 3:30 AM on several nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Del Taco's official page identifies the restaurant at 1495 N Garey Ave and lists service until 3:30 AM Tuesday–Saturday, midnight Sunday, and midnight Monday.
cards.source_title: Del Taco in Pomona, California — 1495 N Garey Ave
cards.access_notes: Store hours run to 3:30 AM Tuesday–Saturday and midnight Sunday–Monday; verify the displayed schedule before departure.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell — 690 N. Indian Hill Blvd
cards.title: The Indian Hill 3 AM Window
cards.subtitle: Indian Hill Boulevard in Pomona
cards.notes: Plan on drive-through service after the dining room closes, and arrange a vehicle before making this late run.
cards.short_summary: A Pomona Taco Bell whose drive-through operates until 3:00 AM nightly.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official location page identifies 690 N. Indian Hill Blvd and lists drive-through hours from 8:00 AM to 3:00 AM every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 690 N. Indian Hill Blvd, Pomona
cards.access_notes: Drive-through closes at 3:00 AM daily; the official page lists dine-in closing at 10:00 PM.

cards.title: The North Garey Weekend Extension
cards.subtitle: North Garey Avenue in Pomona
cards.notes: Choose this branch when heading north through Pomona; use the drive-through schedule for service after 10 PM.
cards.short_summary: A second named Garey Avenue stop with longer Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official page identifies 2204 N Garey and lists drive-through hours until 1:30 AM Sunday–Thursday and 2:30 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 2204 N Garey, Pomona
cards.access_notes: Drive-through closes at 1:30 AM Sunday–Thursday and 2:30 AM Friday–Saturday; dine-in generally closes earlier.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 100 E Holt Ave
cards.title: The Holt Avenue Weekend Stretch
cards.subtitle: East Holt Avenue in central Pomona
cards.notes: Use the drive-through for the late window; the lobby closes at 9 PM, well before overnight service ends.
cards.short_summary: A central Pomona drive-through open later on Friday and Saturday nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box's official page identifies 100 E Holt Ave and lists drive-through service until 2:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box at 100 E Holt Ave, Pomona
cards.access_notes: Drive-through closes at 2:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 AM Friday–Saturday; lobby closes at 9:00 PM daily.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 1335 N Dudley St
cards.title: The Dudley Street 2:30 Window
cards.subtitle: North Dudley Street in Pomona
cards.notes: Head here only with drive-through access after 8:30 PM, when the lobby closes but food service continues.
cards.short_summary: A North Dudley branch with a consistent 2:30 AM drive-through close.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box's official page identifies 1335 N Dudley St and lists drive-through hours from 4:00 AM to 2:30 AM every day.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box at 1335 N Dudley St, Pomona
cards.access_notes: Drive-through operates 4:00 AM–2:30 AM daily; lobby hours end at 8:30 PM.

cards.title: The Indian Hill Patio Stop
cards.subtitle: Indian Hill Boulevard south of I-10
cards.notes: Check the normal schedule before driving over; patio seating and drive-through service are listed for this branch.
cards.short_summary: A north Pomona burger stop open past midnight seven days a week.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out's official page identifies 1851 Indian Hill Blvd and lists normal hours until 1:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: In-N-Out Burger — 1851 Indian Hill Blvd, Pomona
cards.access_notes: Normal hours end at 1:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 AM Friday–Saturday; drive-through and patio seating are listed.

cards.title: The South Pomona Patio Stop
cards.subtitle: Garey Avenue north of the 60 Freeway
cards.notes: Pair this southbound stop with the posted late schedule, and note that the branch lists patio rather than indoor seating.
cards.short_summary: A south Pomona burger counter with drive-through and late patio service.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out's official page identifies 2505 Garey Ave and lists normal hours until 1:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: In-N-Out Burger — 2505 Garey Ave, Pomona
cards.access_notes: Normal hours end at 1:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 AM Friday–Saturday; drive-through and patio seating are listed.

cards.title: The Friday-and-Saturday Midnight Table
cards.subtitle: Rio Rancho Road in south Pomona
cards.notes: Reserve this sit-down option for Friday or Saturday; on other nights, its official closing time is 10 PM.
cards.short_summary: A dine-in breakfast restaurant whose weekend schedule reaches midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP's official page identifies 50 Rio Rancho Rd and lists restaurant hours until midnight Friday–Saturday and 10:00 PM Sunday–Thursday.
cards.source_title: IHOP at 50 Rio Rancho Rd, Pomona
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight Friday–Saturday; Sunday–Thursday service ends at 10:00 PM. Dine-in is listed as an amenity.

warnings: Late service at several fast-food destinations is drive-through-only after the lobby closes; verify same-day hours and transportation before departure.
IHOP qualifies only on Friday and Saturday, when its official schedule extends to midnight.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Cal Poly Pomona spaces for studying, making, recreation, art, and outdoor meet-ups, each supported by a direct campus or Associated Students source.

cards.entity_name: George and Sakaye Aratani Japanese Garden
cards.title: Pause by the Japanese Garden
cards.subtitle: Cal Poly Pomona campus
cards.notes: Use the bridges, pond, and small amphitheater as an easy outdoor meeting point; check campus event or reservation guidance before planning a formal gathering.
cards.short_summary: A landscaped 1.3-acre garden with a pond, waterfall, bridges, and walkways.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Poly Pomona describes the George and Sakaye Aratani Japanese Garden as a 1.3-acre garden with a pond, waterfall, bridges, walkways, fountain, and small amphitheater.
cards.source_title: Special Venues on Campus
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus venue; the university lists it among special venues, so confirm any event or photography requirements in advance.

cards.title: Meet at the Rose Garden gazebo
cards.subtitle: North of the CLA building
cards.notes: Choose the gazebo and floral rows for a daylight outdoor rendezvous or a quick photo stop, then leave the garden as you found it.
cards.short_summary: A rose garden with a white gazebo and more than 230 rose varieties.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says the Rose Garden north of the CLA building has a white wood gazebo and more than 230 rose varieties tended by floriculture students.
cards.source_title: Special Venues on Campus
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus venue; confirm reservation requirements before organizing a group activity.

cards.title: Use Union Plaza as a waypoint
cards.subtitle: Original Kellogg stable building
cards.notes: Set a meet-up at the Russell & Ruth Mawby Fountain, then use the courtyard’s long central path to orient the next stop on campus.
cards.short_summary: A courtyard in the original Kellogg stable building, anchored by a named fountain.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Poly Pomona identifies Union Plaza Courtyard as being in the original Kellogg stable building and says it contains the Russell & Ruth Mawby Fountain.
cards.source_title: Special Venues on Campus
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus courtyard; comply with posted event and reservation rules.

cards.title: Start a study session at the Library
cards.subtitle: Building 15
cards.notes: Use the Library’s study-room reservation link for a group plan, or begin with its computers and service desks when you need a focused campus base.
cards.short_summary: The main library offers study rooms, computers, collections, and research support.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Library site provides a study-room reservation link, and its about page notes more than 40 study rooms and hundreds of computers.
cards.source_title: University Library
cards.access_notes: Building 15; consult the Library’s current hours and reserve a room when needed.

cards.title: Book a Library group study room
cards.subtitle: University Library, Building 15
cards.notes: Gather two or more people, reserve one room through the Library system, and keep the session within the current three-hour maximum.
cards.short_summary: Reservable Library rooms for small groups working together.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library’s group-study-room policy requires a group of two or more and sets a maximum reservation length of three hours.
cards.source_title: Group Study Room Reservation
cards.access_notes: Reservations use a CPP email confirmation; bookings outside Library hours are not honored.

cards.title: Make a prototype in the Maker Studio
cards.subtitle: University Library, second floor
cards.notes: Schedule a tour or reserve the studio before bringing a project; its listed tools include 3D printing, laser cutting, sewing, and vinyl work.
cards.short_summary: A Library makerspace for hands-on prototyping across majors.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Innovation Idea Labs says the Maker Studio is on the University Library’s second floor and lists 3D printing, laser, soldering, sewing, vinyl, and other equipment.
cards.source_title: Student Innovation Idea Labs: Spaces
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are Monday through Friday, noon to 5 p.m.; reservations or tours are available through SIIL.

cards.title: Take a break in the Games Room
cards.subtitle: Bronco Student Center, Building 35-1110
cards.notes: Plan a low-key break with billiards, consoles, or air hockey, and check ASI’s current facility-hours page before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A Bronco Student Center recreation room with games and the campus Lost and Found.
cards.evidence_claim: ASI says the Games Room in the Bronco Student Center offers billiards, gaming consoles, air hockey, and serves as the official CPP Lost and Found.
cards.source_title: Bronco Student Center Info
cards.access_notes: Located in Building 35-1110; ASI publishes current Games Room hours separately and notes that hours may change.

cards.title: Plan an open-swim pool break
cards.subtitle: Bronco Recreation and Intramural Complex
cards.notes: Check current pool hours and lifeguard availability, then bring only permitted equipment or use the listed checkout items during open swim.
cards.short_summary: A 10-lane lap and recreation pool with an outdoor lounge area.
cards.evidence_claim: ASI describes the BRIC Pool and Poolside Lounge as having 10 lap lanes, a recreational swim area, and lounge furniture; pool use requires operating hours and a lifeguard on duty.
cards.source_title: BRIC Pool
cards.access_notes: Use only during operating hours when a lifeguard is on duty; follow ASI pool rules and current hours.

cards.title: Try a route at Bronco Peak
cards.subtitle: Inside the Bronco Recreation and Intramural Complex
cards.notes: Check in with staff first; new climbers can use Try-A-Climb, while later open climbing requires the listed orientation and safety steps.
cards.short_summary: The BRIC’s indoor climbing wall and bouldering feature.
cards.evidence_claim: ASI identifies Bronco Peak as the BRIC climbing wall and says Try-A-Climb is a free program with no prerequisites; it also requires new users to check in with staff.
cards.source_title: Bronco Peak Climbing Wall
cards.access_notes: Check current open-wall hours; ASI requires an orientation and belay class before open climbing, with staff check-in for new climbers.

cards.entity_name: W. Keith & Janet Kellogg University Art Gallery
cards.title: See what is on view at Kellogg Gallery
cards.subtitle: Building 35A, 3801 West Temple Ave.
cards.notes: Look up the current exhibition before visiting, then use the gallery’s contact details to confirm access or arrange a self-guided or group visit.
cards.short_summary: A campus art gallery presenting exhibitions and maintaining a collection.
cards.evidence_claim: The gallery’s official site identifies the W. Keith & Janet Kellogg University Art Gallery, while its contact page lists its Building 35A campus address.
cards.source_title: About the W. Keith & Janet Kellogg University Art Gallery
cards.access_notes: Gallery access and exhibition schedules can vary; confirm current details with the gallery before visiting.
